source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
During the opponent's [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase), in its Battle-shock step, each enemy unit below its **Starting Strength** and within 9" of Be’lakor has to make a Battle-shock test. Here, a unit whose Starting Strength is 1 counts as below it while it has lost any wounds.

Be’lakor also regains up to D3 of its lost wounds for each enemy unit within 9" of it whose Battle-shock test fails.

effects.condition: below Starting Strength or one-model starting unit with lost wounds

effects.trigger: enemy unit in range fails Battle-shock test
